Contact Notre Dame's Global Safety & Security Team with questions Where Notre Dame meets the world and the world meets Notre Dame At Notre Dame, we believe no idea is too bold, no dream is too big, and no flight is too far. And at Notre Dame Global, we implore you to explore further. Whether you’re a professor looking to expand your research into a new country, or a student toying with the idea of international service, or an international scholar wondering how a Notre Dame experience could change your trajectory, Notre Dame Global can help you explore a number of opportunities. From our 12 global locations, to our study abroad opportunities in 26 countries, to countless partnerships with international universities, libraries, and organizations, our network is here to serve you as you explore ways to serve the common good. Our job is to make the world accessible to you. Yours, in turn, is to answer the call to become a global citizen and to use the wisdom and experience you gain to enrich campus, colleagues, and our entire Notre Dame community. Explore Further Global Network With an expansive network across the globe - including our 12 global locations, and numerous partnerships and programs – NDG offers countless opportunities for research, collaboration, and education. Global Network Faculty Research As faculty research extends into global domains, NDG is prepared to leverage its international network, partnerships, and funding to help expand scholarship which promotes good in the world. Learn More International Student and Scholar Affairs Our international students are essential to the richness of the Notre Dame community, so we at NDG make certain they immediately feel at home under the Dome. Learn More Study Abroad It’s easy to boast about our study abroad program – 26 countries, 48 programs, and more than 1,200 student travelers each year – but the experience promises not only to transport our participants, but also to transform them. Learn More Global Engagement Programs For international high school, undergraduate, or graduate students who want a taste of Notre Dame, NDG’s short-term programs welcome you to campus for a summer, semester, or academic-year. Learn More Global Safety & Security Preparing for international activity involves more than booking a ticket, Global Safety & Security is ready to equip every member of the Notre Dame community for safe and well-informed global engagement. They go further. For the more than 70 percent of Notre Dame undergraduates who witness the bustle of downtown Tokyo or the quiet historic ruins of Athens, who speak French in the lush Loire Valley or Spanish with Chilean host families in Santiago, who immerse themselves in life in Singapore, Senegal, South Korea, or Spain, the results are life-changing. Our students do more—they intern with start-ups; integrate their academics with local service opportunities; research with leading academics, often in another language; and come away with a heightened sense of curiosity and responsibility for their world. At Notre Dame Global, we believe our students can go as far as an opportunity takes them. We’re here to make it possible. WHY STUDY ABROAD? WHO CAN STUDY ABROAD?
